Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

buy — to get something with money. Example: I buy the blue one.
room — a part of a building with walls. Example: The fitting room is over there.
size — how big or small clothes are. Example: What size are you?
fit — to be the right size. Example: It fits well.
big — large in size. Example: The trousers are too big.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Can I try it on?
• Where is the fitting room?
• It fits well.
• It is too big.
• Do you have a smaller size?
